$comment: FIXTURE: a module referenced as a whole whose REACHED schemas carry non-schema data (arrays, maps, literals) and boolean subschemas. The tree-shaker must leave every one of these byte-for-byte intact: a reached schema may only lose unreferenced `$defs`. Any `null` item, emptied map, or dropped key below is a sweep bug.
title: Used whole data
description: A module referenced in its entirety that carries data-bearing keywords inside reached schemas.

status.$comment: `enum` is a data array inside a reached schema -> items must stay literals, never become `null`. `meta:enum` is a non-schema map -> entries must not be emptied.
status.title: Status

level.$comment: `const`, `examples` and `default` are literal data in a reached schema -> must stay as is.
level.title: Level

flags.$comment: `properties` map that contains BOOLEAN subschemas. Booleans are not schema objects, so `subschemas()` never yields them; the sweep must nevertheless keep the keys `anything`/`nothing` with their boolean values.
flags.title: Flags

tags.$comment: `items` is a schema; `uniqueItems`/`minItems` are scalars in a reached schema -> kept.
tags.title: Tags

unusedDef.$comment: The ONLY thing the tree-shaker is allowed to drop from this module.
unusedDef.title: Unused def
unusedDef.description: A definition nothing reachable refers to.
